### 🏢 Company & Role Details
- **Company Name:** (e.g. Swiggy, Uber, OpenAI, PhonePe, Grab)
- **Role & Level:** (e.g. Android SDE-2, Senior iOS Engineer, Mobile Tech Lead)
- **Interview Date / Year:** (e.g. October 2026)
- **Location / Mode:** (e.g. Bangalore, India / Remote / Hybrid)
- **Outcome (Optional):** Offer / Rejected / In Progress

---

### 🔄 Rounds Breakdown

#### 🔹 Round 1: Online Assessment / Screening
- **Duration:** (e.g. 60 mins)
- **Topics & Questions Asked:** (e.g. DSA questions, platform fundamentals)

#### 🔹 Round 2: Machine Coding / Live Coding
- **Duration:** (e.g. 90 mins)
- **Problem Statement:** (e.g. Build an infinite scrolling stock watchlist with real-time price updates)
- **Evaluation Criteria:** (e.g. Clean architecture, error handling, unit tests)

#### 🔹 Round 3: Mobile System Design & Architecture
- **Duration:** (e.g. 60 mins)
- **System Designed:** (e.g. Design offline-first messaging app like WhatsApp)
- **Deep-Dive Topics:** (e.g. SQLite conflict resolution, push notification latency, battery efficiency)

#### 🔹 Round 4: Hiring Manager & Behavioral (STAR)
- **Topics Discussed:** (e.g. Handling production regressions, cross-functional conflicts, roadmap prioritization)

### 💡 Preparation Advice & Lessons Learned
What worked well? What caught you by surprise? What advice would you give to candidates preparing for this company?
